description: Mid-performance shot on an outdoor amphitheater stage: a female dancer is lifted onto her partner's shoulder with arms spread wide while three other couples spin behind them, skirts flaring; all in the team's white-shirt, black-skirt/jeans and cowboy boots uniform.
suggested_use: Homepage hero image (dancers mid-lift, high energy)

description: Formal full-team group photo in front of the Texas A&M Administration Building: about 22 members in two rows, guys in black cowboy hats making an A-frame arm pose, girls in fringed vests and maroon ATM boots posing in front.
The full team posed on the steps of the Texas A&M Administration Building showing signature moves: shoulder sits, cradle lifts, and head-down dips, framed by the building's tall columns.
suggested_use: Alternate hero or About page banner

description: Wide shot of six couples country swing dancing on an outdoor pavilion stage, black skirts twirling mid-spin, wooden slat wall behind them.
Four couples performing outdoors at a tailgate-style event: two women on their partners' shoulders with arms raised, one cradle lift, and two dramatic back-bend dips.

A public dance-lesson class of roughly 30 students in casual clothes and boots posing thumbs-up on the wood dance floor of the Bootstack studio, Aggie Wranglers logo on the wall behind them (photo is somewhat dark).
A Wrangler in white shirt and black cowboy hat teaching/dancing with two little girls in straw cowboy hats at an indoor community event, families watching in the background.

Historical slide titled '1987' with a black-and-white photo of ten couples posed on a staircase in western wear; caption reads that ten couples began teaching dance lessons to raise funds and planned to perform in Nashville on national television after Spring 1987.
Interior of the team's practice facility: large circular 'The Bootstack - Home of the Aggie Wranglers' AW logo painted on the wall above a wood dance floor.
Portrait of one Wrangler couple in uniform (black cowboy hat, white shirts, black skirt) smiling in a dance hold among the white columns of the Administration Building.
suggested_use: Public/private lessons page or testimonials/detail imagery
